About Vellore to Chennai Taxi Service

Root Cabs provides reliable taxi service from Vellore to Chennai, covering a distance of 140 km in approximately 2h 30m. Our experienced drivers are well-versed with the best routes, ensuring a comfortable and timely journey.

Whether you're traveling for business, leisure, or medical purposes, we offer multiple vehicle options including Mini, Sedan, SUV, and MUV to suit your group size and comfort preferences. All fares are transparent with no hidden charges or surge pricing.

Book your Vellore to Chennai taxi online through our website or app, or call us at +91 8608606474 for instant booking. We also offer the reverse route: Chennai to Vellore at the same competitive rates.
